item.title: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini vs DeepSeek: which one is worth paying for?
item.description: Four AI assistants, four pricing philosophies. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek compared on price, free tiers, and what each one is actually best at. Prices checked October 2026.

item.title: OpenAI's models are coming to Google Cloud
item.description: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna are rolling out in private preview on Google Cloud's model garden, billed through Google Cloud Marketplace. What was announced, what is still coming, and why it matters.

item.title: Why does AI sometimes make up answers?
item.description: Language models predict the next word, they do not check facts. Here is how the mechanism works, and when you should be careful.

item.title: Mistral Large 4, the trillion-parameter bet from Europe
item.description: Announced on October 6, 2026, this 1-trillion-parameter model is promised with open weights by month's end. What is certain and what is still a promise, separated.

item.title: When are AI tools actually useful? (and when not)
item.description: AI tools shine at specific, well-defined tasks. For vague high-stakes decisions, they are brainstorming partners, not judges.

item.title: Why DNS only has 13 root servers
item.description: The global DNS system is constrained to 13 logical root servers, and the reason comes down to a packet size limit set in the 1980s.
